THIS WRIT PETITION IS FILED UNDER ARTICLES 226 AND 227 OF THE CONSTITUTION OF INDIA, PRAYING TO DIRECT THE RESPONDENTS TO CONSIDER THE REPRESENTATIONS SUBMITTED BY THE PETITIONERS DATED 17/11/2014 AND 23/01/2019 RESPECTIVELY VIDE ANNEXURE-E AND H AND PASS FRESH AWARD TO PAY THE COMPENSATION AMOUNT AND ETC.
 -3-  NC: 2024:KHC-D:7174  WP No. 114466 of 2019  THIS PETITION COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned HCGP for respondents/State.
2.
The petitioners have filed this petition being aggrieved by the orders for having not considered their representation at Annexures-E and H by respondent No.2.

It is the case of the petitioners that they are the owners of the sites/properties bearing 46/1, 46/2, 49/2, 52, 60/2, 69, 67, 43, 85 and 63 which are the open sites situated at Kesarpenti village in Hunagund Taluk, Bagalkot District.
Respondent No.2 appears to have acquired the properties belonging to the petitioners by virtue of notification issued under Section 4(1) of the Act for the purpose of back water of Narayanpur Dam.
But however while passing the award, the compensation is shown as nil amount in respect of the lands belonging to the petitioners.

Therefore, aggrieved by the same, the petitioners made a representation to respondent Nos.1 and 2 on 17.11.2014 requesting to consider the case of the petitioners as they are the owners of the properties and they have been NC: 2024:KHC-D:7174 regularly paying tax.

In view of the fact that the petitioners are stated to be the owners and they have been paying the tax with respect to the properties mentioned herein above, the representation after have been considered by the respondents and replied accordingly, same is not entertained.
The petition requires to be allowed.
Hence, it is allowed.

Accordingly, I pass the following:

3 ORDER i) The petition is allowed.
ii) The writ of mandamus is issued to respondent No.1 to consider the representations dated 17.11.2014 and 23.01.2019 vide Annexures-E and H and pass suitable orders within a period of three months from the date of receipt of the copy of this order.
iii) Respondent No.1 is directed to consider the representation and pass suitable orders in accordance to law.
